document_description: Read `.claude/commands/eap-push.md` for the full workflow. Check for uncommitted changes first — offer to commit them before pushing. Show what commits will be pushed. Warn and confirm before pushing to `main` or `master`. Never use `--force` or `--force-with-lease` unless explicitly asked. Set upstream with `-u origin <branch>` if not yet set.
